question: Who was the first female Indian wrestler to win Gold at the Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geeta Phogat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geeta Phogat** is the first female Indian wrestler to win Gold at the Commonwealth Games.
 
• She achieved this historic win in the **2010 Commonwealth Games** held in Delhi.
 
• Geeta Phogat's victory was a significant milestone for Indian wrestling, especially for women in the sport.
 
• Her achievement has inspired many young female wrestlers in India to pursue the sport professionally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geeta Phogat** hails from a family of wrestlers, with her father **Mahavir Singh Phogat** being a former wrestler and her coach.
 
• Her life and achievements were notably portrayed in the Bollywood film **"Dangal"**, where her character was played by actress **Fatima Sana Shaikh**.
 
• Geeta's sister, **Babita Phogat**, is also a renowned wrestler and has won multiple medals at international events.
 
• The Phogat sisters have contributed significantly to raising the profile of women's wrestling in India.
